baseline_contract: The best measured generation-1 champion field is provided as the initial field; its independently checked energy defines the reproducible state baseline. It is not the private lower witness.
selection_policy: At least two valid, physically/topologically diagnosed gaps >=0.5 in each of three families. Prefer gaps surviving a generation-1 replay from the supplied warm state. Do not select infrastructure failures or unconverged baselines.
witness_policy: Select only stored independently checked feasible fields; never assert global optimality or infer same-budget solvability from offline witnesses.
fallback: If no substantive gaps persist, report robust_solved_for_searched_space; if witnesses exist but no bounded general solver passes, proposed_solvability_unknown.
